summary.headline: Cloud-native endpoint tutorial removes configuration comparison
summary.summary: The tutorial removed its tip comparing this guide with Windows in cloud configuration, including the table describing each solution's objective and the Windows 10 support callout.
summary.adminImpact: Use the linked solution documentation directly when deciding whether to build a custom cloud-native configuration or use Windows in cloud configuration.

summary.headline: Windows Driver update management article published
summary.summary: A new consolidated article documents driver update policies: automatic or manual approval, pausing and approving drivers, prerequisites, supported editions, GCC limitations, RBAC, deployment planning, and reporting.
summary.adminImpact: Review the documented licensing, device, telemetry, endpoint, and RBAC requirements before creating or changing driver update policies.

summary.headline: Windows quality update policy article published
summary.summary: A new article documents using the Windows quality update policy to deploy Hotpatch security updates through Autopatch, including benefits and prerequisites.
summary.adminImpact: Validate device eligibility and Autopatch requirements before planning Hotpatch deployment.

summary.headline: Driver update prerequisites align with other update policies
summary.summary: The driver update overview replaced its telemetry guidance with the shared device-configuration requirements, including enrollment, Entra join state, required telemetry, the Sign-In Assistant service, and Windows Update and Autopatch endpoints.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm targeted devices meet the listed enrollment, join, telemetry, service, and network requirements.

summary.headline: Feature update article removes duplicate limitations and next steps
summary.summary: The article removed the Microsoft Entra registered-device limitations section and its next-steps links, leaving the core policy guidance in the main article.
summary.adminImpact: Consult the Windows Update policy limitations guidance if evaluating Microsoft Entra registered devices.

summary.headline: Windows update overview clarifies policy and Autopatch relationship
summary.summary: The overview renamed the Windows Update client policy section and clarified that each update policy type has its own prerequisites, while feature, quality, driver, and Hotpatch use the same backend service as Autopatch.
summary.adminImpact: Check the prerequisites in each policy article instead of assuming a single identical prerequisite set.

summary.headline: January in-development list adds partner, filter, DDM, and MTD items
summary.summary: The in-development page added planned items: an Intune admin center link to Lenovo Device Orchestration for Windows 11, Android settings catalog filtering by management mode, DDM assignment filters for Apple software updates, expanded managed-app device-management filter values, and Zimperium certificate inventory sync.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate these as planned capabilities only; identify relevant Android, Apple, Windows 11, and Zimperium workflows for future testing.

summary.headline: Android settings catalog link corrected
summary.summary: The in-development entry changed the Android Intune settings catalog settings-list link to a relative documentation path.
summary.adminImpact: No tenant configuration change; use the corrected link when reviewing the planned Android management-mode filter.

summary.headline: Co-management update reference points to Windows updates index
summary.summary: The co-management Windows Update workload guidance now links to the Windows software updates index rather than the former configure page.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change; use the updated landing page for Intune Windows update guidance.

summary.headline: Driver reporting setup moved out of overview
summary.summary: The driver overview removed the Windows diagnostic-data reporting section and its steps to enable the Windows data setting in Intune.
summary.adminImpact: Use the driver reports article for diagnostic-data setup instead of the overview.

summary.headline: Driver reports article adds diagnostic-data setup
summary.summary: The driver reports article now states that Windows diagnostic data must be enabled and gives the Intune path: Tenant administration > Connectors and tokens > Windows data, then enable the processor-configuration setting.
summary.adminImpact: Enable the stated Windows diagnostic-data setting if driver update reports are required.

summary.headline: Feature update report references streamlined
summary.summary: The article removed duplicate device prerequisite text and corrected the organizational-report anchor from Windows 10 feature updates to Windows feature updates.
summary.adminImpact: Follow the feature update policy prerequisites referenced by the report article.

summary.headline: Windows 10 feature update article refreshes guidance links
summary.summary: The article updated its link to the feature update policy creation procedure while retaining the guidance to reassign Windows 10 devices that cannot run Windows 11.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current feature update policy procedure when configuring Windows 10 or Windows 11 targeting.

summary.headline: Feature update article points to Windows 10 upgrade guidance
summary.summary: The Windows 10-to-Windows 11 upgrade link now directs to the separate feature-updates-windows-10 article rather than an anchor in the main article.
summary.adminImpact: No policy behavior changed; use the linked article for Windows 10 upgrade instructions.

summary.headline: Driver policy prerequisites link updated
summary.summary: The driver policy article now links its prerequisite, deployment-planning, and FAQ reference to the renamed driver-updates article.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change; follow the current driver updates article before deployment.

summary.headline: Quality update landing-page link updated
summary.summary: The Windows updates index changed its quality updates Learn more link from quality-updates-policy.md to the renamed quality-updates.md article.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change; use the new quality updates article as the documentation entry point.

summary.headline: Archived driver update reference renamed
summary.summary: The archived What's New entry now links Windows driver update policy guidance to driver-updates.md instead of driver-updates-overview.md.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change; follow the current driver updates documentation.

summary.headline: Windows diagnostic data page updates driver-report link
summary.summary: The Windows diagnostic data page now links the Windows driver updates report to driver-updates.md rather than the retired overview article.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change; retain diagnostic-data enablement where driver update reporting is needed.

summary.headline: Company Portal download command documented
summary.summary: The Company Portal article now tells administrators to use `winget install "Company Portal" --source msstore` to download the Windows Company Portal app and its dependencies.
summary.adminImpact: Use the documented winget command when obtaining the Company Portal app from Microsoft Store.

summary.headline: App monitoring article clarifies AOSP error guidance
summary.summary: The app monitoring article refreshed its wording and clarified several Android AOSP line-of-business app error descriptions and administrator actions, including conflicts, network failures, size limits, and download validation.
summary.adminImpact: Use the updated AOSP error table when troubleshooting app installation and download failures.

summary.headline: Driver updates overview article removed after rename
summary.summary: The former driver-updates-overview.md article was removed as part of the documentation rename to the consolidated driver-updates.md article.
summary.adminImpact: Update saved links and internal references to use driver-updates.md.

summary.headline: Quality updates policy article removed after rename
summary.summary: The former quality-updates-policy.md article was removed as part of the documentation rename to quality-updates.md.
summary.adminImpact: Update saved links and internal references to use quality-updates.md.

summary.headline: Windows Driver updates FAQ published
summary.summary: A new FAQ covers driver policy conflicts, reboot coordination, driver availability and removal, synchronization, pause behavior, extension drivers, co-management, deadlines, deferrals, user experience settings, and inventory timing.
summary.adminImpact: Use the FAQ to plan driver update rings, review schedules, pause expectations, and Configuration Manager coexistence.

summary.headline: Intune audit log retention updated to two years
summary.summary: The privacy data-storage article changed the documented Intune audit-log retention period from up to one year to up to two years; personal data deletion remains described as within 30 days after deletion.
summary.adminImpact: Adjust audit evidence, retention expectations, and compliance procedures to the documented two-year period.

summary.headline: Feature update prerequisites clarify cloud and licensing limits
summary.summary: The article states feature update policies are public-cloud only and not supported in GCC High or DoD, distinguishes Intune Plan 1 from Autopatch-entitled licensing for gradual rollout and optional updates, and clarifies LTSC is unsupported.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm tenant cloud, Windows licensing, and device edition before using feature update policy capabilities such as gradual rollout or optional updates.
